title: NoFlying
description: Toggle elytra flight across the server
body:
# NoFlying
Paper plugin made for Minecraft 1.21.6+, for disabling Elytras flight.

Commands:
- /noflying - toggle elytra flight
- /noflying reload - reload config

<details>
<summary>Config.yml</summary>

```
messages:
  flight-disabled-player: "&cElytra flight is currently disabled!"
  flight-disabled-broadcast: "&eElytra flight has been &cdisabled&e!"
  flight-enabled-broadcast: "&eElytra flight has been &aenabled&e!"
  config-reloaded: "&aNoFlying configuration has been reloaded!"
```

</details>
